# OpenBlocks

> OpenBlocks is a free, local-first notes app for macOS, Windows and Linux. It is a Notion-style block editor on top of an Obsidian-compatible Markdown vault (a plain folder of .md files the user chooses), with databases from page properties, previews of PDF/Word/Excel/PowerPoint/CSV/images, backlinks, a graph, page history, a trash, and templates, an import of whole Notion workspaces (with an integration token or Notion's Markdown & CSV export: pages, databases with typed properties, files, links as wikilinks), an inline ⌘. AI box, and an AI chat whose agents read, edit and organize the vault (and read attached files) using the user's own models (Ollama, LM Studio, Claude Code, Codex, Anthropic/OpenAI-compatible/OpenRouter keys, OpenCue agents, and Gemma 4 running locally, which also reads images and scanned PDFs; EmbeddingGemma 2 finds images by meaning). Its MCP server (`openblocks mcp`) offers one vault or all of them, locally or through a Cloudflare tunnel with a secret token. Part of the AI WorkStudio family (brain, Lumina, OpenCue). Built in Rust (axum + Tauri 2) with a React + TipTap UI. License: Apache-2.0 with the Commons Clause (free to use and modify, cannot be sold).

## Key facts

- Install (macOS/Linux): `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lautaro005/openblocks/main/install.sh | sh`
- Install (Windows PowerShell): `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Lautaro005/openblocks/main/install.ps1 | iex`
- Command: `openblocks` (opens the app), `openblocks serve` (local server only), `openblocks mcp` (MCP server over stdio), `openblocks update`, `openblocks uninstall`
- Local server: `http://127.0.0.1:47880` (loopback only; `X-OpenBlocks: 1` header required for writes)
- Data: pages in the vault; history, trash and chats in `<vault>/.openblocks/`; settings in `~/.openblocks/settings.json`
- Markdown: `[[wikilinks]]`, `![[embeds]]`, `> [!note]` callouts, `- [ ]` tasks, `==highlights==`, `#tags`, YAML frontmatter properties, `<details>` toggles
- MCP tools: search_pages, read_page, list_pages, backlinks, create_page, edit_page, set_property, write_artifact, write_spreadsheet (+ web_search, web_fetch, brain_search, lumina_search with `--with`)
- Editor: ⌘F / Ctrl+F find and replace (case, whole word, regex); drag a rectangle from the margin to select blocks; up to 4 columns (`<div class="ob-columns">` + `<div class="ob-column">`), toggle headings (`<details data-heading="2">`), headings 1-4
- HTML artifacts: `.html` files shown running in the app (View/Code toggle), sandboxed (no network except jsDelivr/cdnjs/unpkg/esm.sh CDNs); spreadsheets linked with `<meta name="openblocks-data" content="file.xlsx">` are read with `openblocks.table()`, `openblocks.rows()`, `openblocks.sheets()`; embed with `![[file.html|height]]`
- Spreadsheets: .xlsx/.csv/.tsv editor with formulas (SUM/SUMA, AVERAGE/PROMEDIO, IF/SI…); PDFs in a built-in pdf.js viewer
- Tabs: optional (Settings → General → Tabs), ⌘T / ⌘⌥W, Ctrl+Tab, ⌘-click in the sidebar opens in a new tab
- Folders can open on an HTML page of their own (folder view → HTML page); `/page` makes a linked page; the right panel (preview, AI, history) is resizable
- Appearance: Settings → Appearance (theme, palette, accent, fonts, text size, line spacing, page width, interface zoom)
- Sidebar: resizable, floats over the page when hidden; folders open by name and sort by name, date, type or by hand
- Import from Notion: Settings → Import (integration token or the `.zip` export) into a new vault folder
- No accounts, no telemetry, no servers of its own

## Family

- [AI WorkStudio](https://lautaro005.github.io/workstudio/): workspace that joins the apps and a single MCP server; OpenBlocks registers itself in `~/.workstudio/apps.json`
- [brain](https://lautaro005.github.io/brain/): long-term memory MCP server
- [Lumina](https://lautaro005.github.io/lumina/): meeting notes and transcripts
- [OpenCue](https://lautaro005.github.io/opencue/): personal AI agents
